knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Handling stops and trained personnel take over. The worker does not pick up or sort.
The container is recorded and referred. It is not opened, emptied or placed in general waste.
The log records observations and actions taken or not taken, without opening the item.

practicalCriteria: In a training set-up with inert props, the learner stops, isolates the area on paper and writes the hazard log entry without touching any prop.
The learner names the trained personnel the referral goes to and the time of escalation.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: Any sharp, container or unknown material is handled, opened or sorted.
Material is placed in general waste.
